title: The iPhone FairPlay probe records modern-access: on a playback error
acceptance: navigator.requestMediaKeySystemAccess is called as a bound method; a unit test with a receiver-checked stub resolves ok after one call, and the same stub rejecting an unbound call fails the old code (regression lock).
The probe has a short timeout (about 2 s) that resolves a distinct word such as timeout, and a never-settling stub does not delay play().
The probe runs after instance.play() is called, or is not awaited before it, so it cannot use up the iOS user gesture.
Owner device check: after deploy, the iPhone Safari failure shows modern-access: <word>, recorded on RF-29.
nextAction: Owner decision first: RF-29 says not to add another probe; this fixes the existing #634/#636 probe rather than adding one. Then move to Ready. Files: apps/web/src/lib/musickit.ts and its tests. Owner-gated paths: the PR needs owner-approved.

evidence.summary: Proposed as packet 1 of the 2026-10-28 Claude audit at 4c344e2. Audit-only proposal; not reverified at intake.

AUD-002 (P2, confirmed in real Chromium): the probe calls requestMediaKeySystemAccess unbound, so it throws and modern-access: can never appear. Repro and evidence files are listed in the audit package.
